flags.summary: The party met the lost Ghostlight passenger on the wreck road (roads/act1:lost_passenger).
The party met the bonfire keeper at the moor crossing (roads/act1:bone_bonfire).
The bonfire keeper told the party who the fire is for.
A hero gave the bone bonfire a lock of hair: the cult has it now, and the Crooked Man knows.
The party met the lost child in the orange shawl on the wreck road.
The lost child got home to Wickermoor (walked or shown the way).
The lost child went off into the woods alone.
The party came on the Green Queen's wayside shrine in an oak.
The party emptied the wayside shrine's offering bowl.
A hero studied the shrine's carving (the crooked crown under the leaves).
The party met the Brightsingers' lantern walk on the hill road.
Joan Murdoch told the party about the manor's wrong-floor candles.
The party met the refugees from burning Foxwillow (roads/act2:foxwillow_refugees).
The Foxwillow refugee told the party about the crows.
The party met the barefoot pilgrim bound for the Crimson Monastery.
The pilgrim told the party about the monastery and its abbot.
The party met the drowned gambler on the swamp causeway.
The drowned gambler told the party about his marker with Mister Crossroads.
The party met the sick Glitterdeep miner on the hill road.
The party met the nameless patient on the marsh road.
The patient told the party about the Matron's medicine.
The party met the funeral with the empty coffin on the cemetery road.
The Crooked Man met the party at the edge of the road after the Crooked House (roads/crooked_man:after_house).
The Crooked Man applauded the first of the Fallen from a milestone.
The party found the Crooked Man's note: five of six.
The Crooked Man called at the party's fire at the interval (four of the Fallen dead).
The Crooked Man called at the party's fire after the sixth of the Fallen, before Fool's Day.
